newsitem.title: UK: IMS shares leap on stock market debut.
newsitem.headline: IMS shares leap on stock market debut.

text.p: Shares in Interactive Media Services Group Plc (IMS) forged ahead on their stock market debut on Thursday, traders said.
The stock was floated at 135p to give market capitalisation of 45 million stg but it rose to 170-1/2 by 1200 GMT on volume of 5.4 million shares. The issue was launched by HSBC James Capel.
"They've got off very well, there has been lots of buying interest," one market-maker said.
IMS is an automated telephony service provider in UK for corporate, media and sports clients. The company hopes deregulation of the telecoms industry will allow it to expand.
"It's been a marvellous issue," another trader said. "Some people are making a quick kill, and other longer-term buyers are moving in."
